question:
Which word is closest in meaning to resignation?

The couple sat in a state of resignation after the tragic news.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2 i.e. Acceptance**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"resignation"** means the acceptance of something undesirable but inevitable. It reflects a sense of passive acknowledgment. (स्वीकार करना)
 
 
• **Example:** She received the bad news with quiet resignation, knowing there was nothing she could do to change it.
 
 
• The correct word here is **"acceptance,"** which means agreeing to or coming to terms with a situation or fact. (स्वीकार करना)
